description: React component for managing recovery key sheet in Notesnook app, including generating, saving, sharing recovery keys and QR codes.

classes.name: RecoveryKeySheet
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing recovery key, including QR code generation, file saving, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the recovery key sheet, optionally in signup mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the recovery key sheet and updates settings.

methods.name: saveQRCODE
methods.description: Generates and saves the recovery key QR code as an image file.

methods.name: saveToTextFile
methods.description: Saves the recovery key as a text file.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Fetches encryption key and user info when the sheet is opened.

methods.name: shareFile
methods.description: Shares the recovery key text file via available sharing options.
